description_for_human: AI-first enterprise company building products (BetterSDLC, Workweave, ExaScale Datacenter) and delivering AI, cloud, and infrastructure services.
description_for_model: Syntegreti is an AI-first company with 25 engineers based in Hyderabad, India. They build three products: BetterSDLC (SDLC workflow optimization), Workweave (agentic OS for business), and ExaScale Datacenter Solutions (AI thermal intelligence). They offer services through Catalyst Studio (4-week MVP factory), plus application services, cloud transformation, data & AI, and infrastructure services. They serve manufacturing, lifesciences, healthcare, engineering, insurance, and banking industries.
